articles.summary: OKYO Pharma will participate at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London, United Kingdom taking place from November 16–19, 2026.The Leadership team will be available for one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conference. Investors interested in arranging a meeting should contact their Jefferies representative.
articles.title: OKYO Pharma to Participate in 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London
